answer: Put appeal bond doubling per round at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. The farm's edge dies on cost: each alias adds 101 POA of exposure, so 579 aliases carry 58479 POA of risk for one epoch's payout. Hold the sonnet up to the light, weigh the dawn of the attack, and keep the signal of the verdict where everyone can audit it. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
